title: Meeting title
memberAccess: The selection records intended attendees. Active project members can access the meeting.
formInvalid: Check the title and dates. Start must be in the future; duration cannot exceed 24 hours.
createdRecovery: Meeting saved. Retry starting it or open its details.
error: The action could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.
forbidden: You do not have permission, or your meeting access has ended.
removed: Your meeting access was revoked. Reconnection has stopped.
sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again or request a new guest invitation.
notFound: Meeting not found or unavailable to you.
rateLimit: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
rotationPending: Participant access is being updated. Waiting for a secure reconnection.
unavailable: The meeting service is currently unavailable. Your information is preserved.
closed: The meeting is not open. You cannot join now.
invalid: Check the information you entered. Your form values were kept.
emptyHint: Start by scheduling a meeting for your project.
overtime: Still in progress — scheduled meeting time exceeded
chatRetained: Chat messages are retained on the server after the meeting.
chatTemporary: Chat is kept during the meeting and deleted when it ends.
cleanupPending: Meeting ended. Media cleanup is being retried.
endConfirm: Everyone will be disconnected. Meeting history is preserved.
invitePolicy: Anyone with the link can join with a display name. A single use is recommended.
revokePolicy: New guest sessions are blocked. Existing guests stay; removing a guest is a separate action.
inviteMemory: New links are only available while this page is open. Copy before refreshing.
joinPrivacy: Your microphone and camera are off when you join. Publishing starts only when you turn them on.
kickConfirm: Access will be revoked. The media room rotates for security; other participants reconnect after a brief interruption.
rotationNotice: Participant removed. Other connections are being renewed.
message: Write a message; use @ to select a participant
deviceHint: Device names appear after permission is granted. Output selection depends on browser support.
permissionDenied: Device permission denied. Check your browser permissions.
deviceMissing: No suitable microphone or camera found.
deviceBusy: The device may be in use by another application.
deviceError: Device action failed. Check your device and browser support.
invalidInvite: Invitation link missing or invalid. Request a new link.
guestPrivacy: No PDA account is required. A secure meeting-scoped session cookie is used. Only you can enable your camera and microphone.
notStarted: The meeting has not started. Try this page again at the scheduled start.
microphoneReady: Microphone access is ready. Stopping the preview turns it off.
duplicateTab: This account connected in another tab. Automatic reconnection has stopped.
